ratio_shipping-policy_default.title: Shipping Policy
ratio_shipping-policy_default.subtitle: Here's everything you need to know about how and when your order will reach you.

sections.heading: Processing Time
sections.body: Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day.

sections.heading: Shipping Times
bullets: Remote areas may require additional time

sections.heading: Shipping Charges
sections.body: Shipping charges are calculated at checkout based on your location and the shipping method you select. Free shipping may be available on qualifying orders.

sections.heading: Order Tracking
sections.body: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number so you can follow your package all the way to your door.

sections.heading: Delays
sections.body: Occasionally, delivery may be delayed due to weather, carrier issues, or high demand. We appreciate your patience and will keep you informed wherever possible.

sections.heading: International Shipping
sections.body: Where international shipping is available, any customs duties, taxes, or import fees are the responsibility of the recipient.
